{{#ifeq:{{{1|}}}|22 BBY
  |This story is set before "[[Terror on the Twilight|Terror on the ''Twilight'']]", which features the ''[[Twilight/Legends|Twilight]]'', which only featured in the first season of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', which [[The Official Star Wars Fact File (2014)|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' (2014)]] dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Considering that the [[Star Wars comic books|comics]] featured in ''[[Star Wars Comic UK]]'' are published in chronological order, it can be concluded that "{{HideParanthetical|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}}}" takes place in approximately [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].
{{#ifeq:{{{1|}}}|21 BBY
  |This story is set before "[[Heroes on Both Sides]]", which marks the debut of revamped appearances for several main characters and is dated to the start of [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] by {{FactFile|y=2014|56|20 BBY 5-8|Negotiation or Militarisation?}}. Considering that the [[Star Wars comic books|comics]] featured in ''[[Star Wars Comic UK]]'' are published in chronological order, and that "[[Burn the Behemoth!]]" is the first comic in the series to feature the new character models, it can be concluded that "{{HideParanthetical|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}}}" takes place in approximately [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].
|{{#ifeq:{{{2|}}}|20 BBY-1
  |This story is set around the time of "[[Heroes on Both Sides]]", which marks the debut of revamped appearances for several main characters and is dated to the start of [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] by{{FactFile|y=2014|56|20 BBY 5-8|Negotiation or Militarisation?}}, and before "[[Bounty (episode)|Bounty]]", as "[[Mandalorian Memories]]" serves as a prequel to that episode and {{FactFile|y=2014|100|20 BBY 39-40|Battle of Dathomir}} dates "Bounty" to 20 BBY as well. Considering that the [[Star Wars comic books|comics]] featured in ''[[Star Wars Comic UK]]'' are published in chronological order, and that "[[Burn the Behemoth!]]" is the first comic in the series to feature the new character models, it can be concluded that "{{HideParanthetical|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}}}" takes place in 20 BBY.</ref>

Considering that the [[Star Wars comic books|comics]] featured in ''[[Star Wars Comic UK]]'' are published in chronological order, it can be concluded that "{{HideParanthetical|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}}}" takes place in 20 BBY.</ref>
